landing_hero_title: {#first}Jot down what you spent.{/first} {#second}Know where it went.{/second}
landing_hero_lead: Kosha is a free, open-source expense tracker. Add each payment on your phone in a few seconds, then see at your desk how the month compares with a usual one.
landing_pocket_lead: {count} payments, each added as it happened. You notice what you spend while it's fresh, and there's nothing to piece together at the end of the month.
landing_quick_add_body: Kosha reads the amount, date and account, and guesses the rest from what you entered before.
landing_sentence_body: Write it the way you'd say it, and AI fills in the amount, date, payee, category and note.
landing_offline_body: Install Kosha from your phone's browser. New entries you add without a signal sync when you're back online.
landing_receipt_body: Kosha reads the payee, amount, date and time, and converts a receipt in another currency at today's rate.
landing_desk_title: See the month while it's happening
landing_desk_lead: Kosha compares each day with your average for the six months before, so by the 10th you know whether you're on track.
landing_recap_title: Read a note on last month
landing_recap_body: In the first week of each month, Kosha writes what changed and why.
landing_overview_title: Compare it with a usual month
landing_overview_body: Kosha plots spending so far against your usual pace and projects where the month will end. Switch the month or the currency.
landing_ask_body: Answers come from your own entries, with links to the ones behind them.
landing_recurring_body: Set a schedule once. Kosha records a fixed amount on the day it's due and asks you when the amount varies. Skip or change any one payment.
landing_attention_body: Kosha flags a card to pay off, a bill not marked paid, a category above its usual and a value that's out of date.
landing_statements_title: Once a month, check it against the bank
landing_statements_lead: Kosha never asks for your bank login. Import a year of statements and it knows your usual month from day one. Each month after, it ticks off what matches and lists what's missing.
landing_import_body: Kosha reads CSV, OFX and QFX files, and PDFs when AI is on. Bank text turns into payees you recognise.
landing_reconcile_title: Find out why it doesn't add up
landing_reconcile_body: When the difference isn't zero, Kosha runs a bookkeeper's checks, like swapped digits, a wrong sign or a duplicate. Try fixing this one.
landing_accounts_title: Every account in one net worth
landing_accounts_lead: Kosha adds up bank accounts, cash, cards and investments, each in its own currency, at daily exchange rates. Cards count what you owe, and investments count what you put in plus their latest gain.
landing_transfer_body: Transfers between your accounts never count as spending.
landing_ai_lead: Every AI feature is optional and runs on your provider: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Turn on only what you want.
landing_ai_sees_body: Switch payee names off and Kosha sends a code instead, then puts the real name back in the reply.
landing_api_title: Use it from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
landing_api_body: Accounts, entries, recurring payments and statements are also MCP tools and REST endpoints.
landing_closing_title: Start with the next thing you buy
landing_closing_lead: Kosha is free and open source under the MIT licence. Use it here, or run your own copy on Cloudflare.
landing_hosted_body: Your account, in your browser and on your phone. Nothing to install from a store.
landing_fact_offline: Add entries offline on your phone
landing_fact_export: Export to CSV or JSON, any time
landing_fact_ai: AI only with your own key
landing_self_host_body: One Cloudflare Worker and a D1 database. The README has every step, including a script that imports a Cashew backup.
landing_self_host_commands_label: Commands to deploy your own copy
landing_reconcile_missing: On the statement, not in Kosha
landing_reconcile_done_note: Kosha warns before you change a reconciled entry.
landing_transfer_note: Paying off a card and moving savings stay out of income and spending. Only the fee counts.
landing_api_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text instead.
